program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid separator color divides the board into small panels.
    sep_color = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep_color for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    bg_color = next((v for v in grid[0] if v != sep_color), 0)
    mark_color = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (sep_color, bg_color)), None)
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1])]
            count = sum(v == mark_color for v in cells) if mark_color is not None else 0
            row.append(1 if count == 2 else bg_color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator color forms complete horizontal and vertical grid lines.
    sep_candidates = {grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])}
    sep_candidates &= {grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))}
    if not sep_candidates:
        # General fallback: find a color that makes at least one complete row and column.
        sep_candidates = {v for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}
                          if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
                          and any(all(row[c] == v for row in grid) for c in range(w))}
    sep_color = next(iter(sep_candidates))
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep_color for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    bg_color = max((v for v in {x for row in grid for x in row} if v != sep_color),
                   key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    mark_colors = {x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (sep_color, bg_color)}
    mark_color = next(iter(mark_colors)) if mark_colors else None
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1])]
            count = sum(v == mark_color for v in cells) if mark_color is not None else 0
            row.append(1 if count == 2 else bg_color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
